title: Valneva Reports Nine-Month 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Updates

body_markdown:
- **Total product sales of €81.4m**


- Full-year product sales guidance of €135 to €150 million reaffirmed
- New supply contract with U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) expected imminently


- **Cash position of €85.2 million as of September 30, 2026**


- Valneva expects to have sufficient cash runway to reach the first potential Lyme milestone payment, supported by the implementation of restructuring measures in the first half 2026


- **Lyme disease vaccine candidate progressing toward key regulatory decisions in 2027\[1\]**


- European Medicines Agency (EMA) review of Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) ongoing
- New Drug Submission (NDS) filed with Health Canada\[2\]
- U.S. FDA interactions ongoing for planned Biologics License Application (BLA) submission; update expected in the fourth quarter of 2026\[3\]
- Additional Phase 3 VALOR data and conclusions presented at ID Week\[4\]


**Lyon (France), November 24, 2026** –[Valneva SE](http://www.valneva.com/) (Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a vaccine company with proven expertise for advancing differentiated and novel vaccines, today reported its consolidated financial results for the first nine months of the year, ended September 30, 2026, provided key corporate updates, and reaffirmed its financial guidance for 2026. The condensed consolidated interim financial results are available on the Company’s website ([Financial Reports – Valneva](https://valneva.com/investors/financial-reports/) ).


Valneva will provide a live webcast of its nine-month 2026 results conference call beginning at 3 p.m. CET / 9 a.m. ET today. This webcast will also be available on the Company’s website. Please refer to this link:[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/odvcszsa](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/odvcszsa)
